---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the skills, schemas, or validation tooling
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem to solve

What writing or validation task is hard or impossible today?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest change that would solve it.

## Alternatives considered

Anything you tried instead, and why it was not enough.

## Scope check

- [ ] The change keeps writing and publishing separate (no login, upload, or posting).
- [ ] The change does not present editorial preference as an official platform rule.
